name: ZITLAS Protein Crunch Upma
description: Upma rebuilt with a doubled protein load from {p1} and {p2} while keeping the familiar flavour.
instructions: Dry-roast or rinse rava as needed and keep aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, add mustard seeds/cumin and let them splutter.
Add Onion and Capsicum, cook 3-4 minutes until softened.
Fold in soya chunks (rehydrated, chopped) and curd/greek yogurt in the last two minutes so they stay tender, not mushy.
Add the rava with a splash of water/milk as needed, mix, and cook covered until done.
Season with salt and chilli, mix well, and serve hot.
why_it_works: High protein for a breakfast meal
Vegetables add fiber and micronutrient variety

instructions: Dry-roast or rinse rolled oats as needed and keep aside.
Heat oil in a mixer, add mustard seeds/cumin and let them splutter.
Add Cabbage and Carrot, cook 3-4 minutes until softened.
Buy tofu, crumbled in bulk — it keeps for weeks and is the cheapest protein base here.
Add the rolled oats with a splash of water/milk as needed, mix, and cook covered until done.
Season with salt and chilli, mix well, and serve hot.
why_it_works: High protein for a breakfast meal
Vegetables add fiber and micronutrient variety
Practical for everyday preparation
